name: Data Analyst - FinTech
jd_text:
Data Analyst — FinVista Analytics

About the Role:
Join our data team to drive insights from financial datasets.

Requirements:
- Proficiency in SQL for complex queries and data manipulation
- Strong Python skills with pandas, numpy, and matplotlib
- Experience with data visualization tools (Tableau or Power BI)
- Statistical analysis and hypothesis testing
- Experience with Excel and advanced spreadsheet functions
- Understanding of ETL processes

Nice to Have:
- Experience with machine learning basics (scikit-learn)
- Knowledge of financial domain
- Experience with Airflow or similar workflow tools

Responsibilities:
- Analyze large financial datasets to identify trends
- Create dashboards and reports for stakeholders
- Collaborate with engineering to improve data pipelines
- Present findings to non-technical audiences
